run_pipeline: run the pipeline to compare two response methods side-by-side on a dataset of prompts
get_per_prompt_result: get per-prompt side-by-side comparison results between two methods for a single prompt
get_results: get side-by-side comparison results across all prompts with optional parallelization
save_results: save comparison results as a JSON file with configuration attributes and per-prompt data
load_data: load and prepare a dataset of prompts with correct and incorrect answers for evaluation
